content: The VPN client says my certificate expired. What do I do?
Try restarting the VPN client.
That did not help, it still says expired.
Please contact your administrator.
Renew the certificate from the self-service portal, then reconnect.
How do I get access to the finance dashboard?
Ask your manager for access.
Raise an access request in the service catalogue and pick the finance-readers group.
My laptop will not join the guest wifi in the Dublin office.
Forget the network and rejoin it.
Already tried that twice.
Guest wifi is for visitors; put a corporate laptop on the staff network with your device certificate.
Can I install the beta build of the design tool?
Yes, download it from the vendor site.
No. Beta builds need a security review first; open a software request and note that it is a beta.
I am locked out after too many password attempts. How long until it clears?
It should clear eventually.
The lockout clears after 15 minutes, or immediately if you reset the password from an enrolled device.
Where do I find the retention policy for shared drives?
Check the intranet.
Shared drives keep files for 400 days after last access; the policy page is under Workplace, Records.
My new starter has no email address on their first day. Who fixes that?
Email is created automatically.
It has not been, they started this morning.
Provisioning runs the night before the start date; if the start date moved, ask HR to correct it and the account appears within an hour.
Can I use a personal password manager for work logins?
That is usually fine.
No. Work credentials go in the managed password manager only; personal vaults are out of scope for recovery and audit.
The meeting room display will not accept my screen share.
Restart the display.
Screen share needs the room to be on the same VLAN; join the meeting from the room calendar entry rather than sharing directly.
How do I report a phishing email?
Delete it.
Use the Report Phishing button in the mail client; do not delete it first, the button needs the message.
